name: Peruvian Pigeon
rangeDescription: Northern peru (subtropical marañón valley) and adjacent southern ecuador
description: Large, rusty pigeon confined to the Marañon drainage of northwestern Peru. Its range may extend to extreme southern Ecuador, but evidence is lacking.

name: Long-tailed Paradigalla
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (arfak and fakfak mountains)
description: A large, fairly long-tailed bird of montane forest on the Bird’s Head of New Guinea. All black plumage with iridescence on the head, fairly long bill, distinctive, yellow wattle between the eye and the bill.

name: Tarim Babbler
rangeDescription: Northwestern china (xinjiang) from tarim basin to lop nor
description: Uncommon, sandy-colored babbler of dry scrubby and weedy areas, often on hill- and mountain-sides. Readily distinguished from other brown birds in its range by its long tail, thickset appearance, pale brow, and faint dark streaking on the back.

name: Russet-naped Wren
rangeDescription: Arid lowlands of southwestern mexico (colima and southern jalisco to western chiapas)
description: Large wren usually found in small groups, less often in pairs. Mainly found in thorn forest and dry scrubby habitats.

name: Juan Fernandez Tit-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Robinson crusoe island (juan fernández islands, far off southern chile)
description: Restricted to Isla Robinson Crusoe in the Juan Fernandez Islands where no similar species occur. Uncommon and declining.

name: Red-necked Avocet
rangeDescription: Locally in australia
description: Distinctive shorebird with very long and dramatically up-curved bill, dark red head and neck. In flight shows patches of black on the back, shoulders, and wing-tips.

name: Black-hooded Antshrike
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and western panama
description: Antshrikes have large, flat heads and large, hooked bills; they often angle their tails downward, below the line of the body. Male Black-hooded is mostly black with a slightly paler belly; note small white spots on the shoulder.

name: Streaked Bowerbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern papua new guinea (owen stanley mountains)
description: A fairly small bowerbird of foothill and lower montane forest. Dull brown color with some subtle streaking on the throat and breast.

name: Ayacucho Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes of south-central peru (ayacucho, west of the río apurímac between the río mantaro and río pampas)
description: Medium-sized antpitta found only in a small area of the eastern Andes in south central Peru, not far from the city of the same name. Plumage is rich chestnut-brown with a hint of buff on the belly.

name: Pallid Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Australia including tasmania; winters north to wallacea
description: Large pale cuckoo, which lacks the warmer tones of both Fan-tailed and Brush cuckoos. Yellow eyering, and a dark indistinct stripe across the cheek.

name: Red-masked Parakeet
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of western ecuador and northwestern peru
description: A medium-sized green parakeet with a long tail and red underwings and thighs (red on the thighs not easy to see). Similar to Mitred Parakeet, but usually has more red on the face, extending below and behind the eye, as well as red patches on the underwing.

name: Chestnut Seedeater
rangeDescription: Paraguay to south-central brazil, uruguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Handsome seedeater. Males are mostly chestnut with a gray cap, wings, and tail, while females are sandy-colored and difficult to separate from other female seedeaters.

name: Magellanic Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Nothofagus forest of southwestern argentina and southern chile
description: Very large black woodpecker of native forests with large diameter trees, from dense, bamboo-choked temperate rainforest to rather open and stunted woodlands in drier areas. Ranges widely in large territories, often in pairs or family groups.

name: Whistling Kite
rangeDescription: Australia, new guinea, and new caledonia
description: Large sandy-colored raptor. In flight it has a strong underwing pattern, and holds its wings in a bent M-shape.

name: Munchique Wood-Wren
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia
description: A small, stub-tailed wren endemic to Colombia’s western Andes. It has a long, white eyebrow and a streaky face.

name: Robust Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Huge woodpecker found in humid forests including Araucaria forests. The head is mostly red with a short crest and strong greenish bill.

name: Worm-eating Warbler
rangeDescription: Eastern usa; winters southeastern mexico to panama and greater antilles
description: A plain warbler dressed in subtle shades of olive, brown, and buff. Note black and tan stripes on head and long, sharp bill.

name: Spot-winged Monarch
rangeDescription: New guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea), and louisiade archipelago (off southeastern new guinea)
description: A small to medium-sized bird of lowland and foothill forest interior. Slate-gray above with white spots in the wing, white below, black face and silver-gray bill.

name: Sakhalin Grasshopper Warbler
rangeDescription: Sakhalin, southern kuril islands, and hokkaido; winters in philippines
description: A nondescript songbird that skulks in taiga undergrowth, where very difficult to see well. Breeds on Hokkaido, Sakhalin Island, and the Kuril Islands.

name: Malaysian Blue Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southern thai-malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Small flycatcher with brilliant blue upperparts, a pale orange throat and chest, and a white belly. Slightly paler female has a whitish throat, while male’s is blue; sexes are otherwise quite similar.
